blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver the single release-convergence increment that makes the dense final-wave profile reliably resolve and sustain a bounded 32-enemy workload, replaces text-stacked choices with a truthful authored decision hierarchy, and concretely restores larger traversable arena scale, external depth, landmark collision, and ordinary-movement visibility integrity.

diagnosis.root_cause: The prior release-convergence candidate did not produce a valid dense qualification window (software rendering and only six active enemies), while the required player-facing choice and arena-spatial capabilities remain incomplete. Existing dense instrumentation, upgrade scaffolding, and authored cemetery bindings are partial but are not yet contract-complete under the required runtime and movement checks.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule deferred issue ids or unrelated backlog gaps.
Do not weaken the native-renderer qualification gate or count llvmpipe/software evidence as a pass.
Stop after candidate implementation and focused self-validation; GameLoop Runtime and Tester own native recapture, visual analysis, and formal verdicts.

strategy.rationale: Repair the diagnostic runtime binding directly, rebase the authored arena's playable datum and landmark visibility/collision as one spatial contract, and complete the authoritative choice presentation seam. This is a materially different binding/composition strategy from transform tuning and avoids disconnected replacement scenes.

code: Run candidate static checks for dense lifecycle, upgrade projection/application, focus routing, and spatial ownership.
Exercise editor-only dense prepare/advance/reset and a second prepare; verify 25–40 resolved enemies, bounded work counters, zero stale/orphan ownership, and no runtime errors.

Exercise a representative draft with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad; inspect silhouettes/icons, CURRENT-to-NEW truthfulness, maximum three deltas, no NEW/LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, focus states, and exactly-once commit.

Replay ordinary movement around every side of the central building/landmark and along the full perimeter/boundary; inspect larger traversable scale, external world/external depth, collision alignment, disappearance, and occlusion. Re-run native_godot_project and host_godot_boot checks.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime should recapture release_convergence_dense_run_performance_contract at 1920x1080 on the designated native renderer for three complete prepare/advance/reset cycles, retaining software/llvmpipe sessions as rejected or pending evidence.
Tester should compare frame-time distribution, input responsiveness, active/pooled counts, bounded subsystem work, combat causality, reset isolation, and the complete choice interaction matrix.

Tester should perform the ordinary movement replay around the central landmark and perimeter, checking player/enemy collision, external depth visibility, landmark disappearance/occlusion, and boundary behavior.
visual: Capture matched shipped gameplay, level-up draft, pause backdrop, central-landmark approach/departure, perimeter, and dense-wave views at target resolution.

Confirm authored silhouettes/icons, compact stat glyphs, aligned truthful CURRENT-to-NEW values, restrained copy, stable card dimensions, distinct keyboard/mouse/gamepad focus states, larger traversable scale, external world depth, collision-aligned landmark geometry, and no disappearance or occlusion drift.

done_when: The editor-only dense-profile prepare path synchronously resolves the final Bellkeeper-wave definition before density admission and records requested_density 32 with resolved_density between 25 and 40 when the existing pool and spawn datum are healthy.

A four-second dense advance keeps the requested cohort bounded with deterministic neighbor, steering, vitality, presentation, lights, optional-effects, projectile, pickup, and audio budgets; no unbounded allocations, orphan nodes, duplicate timers/signals, stale freed-instance accesses, input lockout, or changes to exactly-once attack/hit/death/drop causality occur.

Dense reset/restart retires or reuses every transient actor and presentation, clears deferred callbacks and cohort state, restores zero live enemies/registered neighbors/transient pickups and clean audio/input ownership on the next frame, and permits a second prepare without cumulative growth.

Replace text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with an authored visual hierarchy: weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful current-to-new values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, never NEW or LOCKED as a placeholder in the CURRENT value column, no unchanged or exhaustive stat rows, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states.

Keyboard focus, mouse hover/click, and gamepad focus/confirm are visibly distinct; unavailable, newly unlocked, and selected states preserve card dimensions, held confirm is debounced, and the authoritative upgrade transaction applies exactly once before gameplay resumes.

Expand or retain a larger traversable scale sized for the camera footprint and route choices; preserve a coherent external world with external depth beyond the playable boundary; align the central building/landmark visible footprint with its collision; prevent landmark disappearance or camera occlusion during approach and departure; keep the perimeter/boundary collision-aligned; and pass an15?

An ordinary movement replay around every side of the central building/landmark and along the full perimeter proves no pass-through, disappearance, occlusion drift, or invisible barrier for the player or representative enemies.

Candidate self-validation covers dense prepare/advance/reset plus a second prepare, representative drafts through keyboard/mouse/gamepad paths, runtime errors, lifecycle counters, arena movement/visibility/collision checks, and unchanged native_godot_project and host_godot_boot behavior.
tasks.instructions: Implement the one release-convergence task across the existing dense runtime, authored arena spatial contract, and upgrade presenter. Trace why the prior profile sampled only six enemies: bind the final-wave pressure before preparation, prevent stale live-cap or spawn-budget clamping of the editor-only 32-enemy cohort, and keep requested/resolved/reset-isolation receipts truthful. Preserve pooled actors, authored weapons/audio, and the complete cemetery package while enforcing deterministic work caps and cancellation for dense lifecycle ownership. Replace the current text-stacked weapon and upgrade choices with weapon or upgrade silhouettes, compact stat icons, truthful CURRENT-to-NEW values for no more than three decision-relevant stat deltas, no NEW or LOCKED CURRENT placeholders, restrained copy, and complete keyboard, mouse, and gamepad focus states. Implement the arena spatial contract concretely: expand to a larger traversable scale where needed, retain an external world with external depth beyond the boundary, align the central building/landmark footprint and collision, repair any disappearance or occlusion during approach/departure, and validate the perimeter/boundary through an ordinary movement replay. Do not replace or duplicate the authored map; use its existing streets, buildings, props, materials, and landmarks. Keep tester-only setup editor-guarded and release-disabled, and do not alter ordinary wave balance or preserved assets.
